## Objective

Build a student grade manager that grades students and derives class
statistics from a dataset.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Students stored as objects with a derived grade
- [ ] Grade banding implemented as a single function
- [ ] Average, highest, lowest and count all derived from the array
- [ ] Average shown to one decimal place
- [ ] Validation covers empty name and out-of-range scores
- [ ] No NaN with zero students
- [ ] Zero console errors
- [ ] Responsive at 360px, 768px and 1280px

- `task-2/task-2.js`
